decisions.reason: The compact trommel screen is a developed version of the established BASIC 518, which already had a customer base, and it sits in the firm's core screening business, so it likely meets aspirations despite the firm's financial strain.
The AK flail shredder series is a flagship mobile line that was upgraded to EU Stage V engines in 2019, signalling continued investment in a core product that performs at or above aspiration.

The mobile high-speed grinder fits the firm's core mobile shredding portfolio and gained its own page in 2019; although a sister grinder was already pruned, this one appears to be the retained variant.

The CERON stationary pre-shredder is lower-volume and lies outside the firm's mobile core, which makes it a possible target for problemistic pruning under limited slack, but it is marketed as setting standards and has documented installations, so keeping it remains more likely.
